dek: Zefr classifies video content for brands and advertisers. Its public site was rebuilt on Craft CMS 5, with a component library editors assemble in Neo, and moved onto Craft Cloud.
short: Zefr's marketing site rebuilt on Craft CMS 5 and moved onto Craft Cloud, with a Neo block library editors build pages from, SAML single sign-on, SEOmatic and a Vite build.

highlights.title: A 500 that was really a missing rewrite
highlights.text: On the preview host, /dist/* missed the CDN artifact bundle and returned 500s. One URLPattern rewrite per path fixed it, because a grouped wildcard did not match every asset.

highlights.title: A block library, not page templates
highlights.text: Callouts, related resources and about-page components were added as Neo blocks, then regrouped in April so module groups matched their types.

highlights.title: Craft Cloud project config
highlights.text: Early commits aligned Craft Cloud settings in project.yaml so local DDEV and Cloud environments built the same site.
